notes: DCA calculated Round 4 present need=0 and prospective need=181. Borough calculated 167 (different land capacity factor); binding resolution adopted January 28, 2025. NJBA challenged; settlement May 5, 2025 set prospective need at 174 units. VLA (based on Round 3 VLA) gives RDP=0, Unmet Need=174. Four additional Veterans' Housing units (324 Main Street) reduce unmet need to 170; Borough must address 25% of 170 (43 units) with realistic zoning. New RC overlay zone (Block 1301, Lots 1.01 & 1.02) proposed at 30 du/ac, 20% set-aside, yielding 234 total units with 47 affordable — exceeds 25% requirement. Existing Round 3 sites: Block 419 (29 aff units, under construction), Veterans' Housing Block 304 Lot 3 (14 units + 4 additional approved). Note: correction vs candidate — candidate had 'Block 610 Lot 1' and 'Old Hook Road overlay' as separate; document shows Block 1301 Lots 1.01 & 1.02 is the Old Hook Road/Main Street overlay site.

sources.title: Housing Plan Element and Fair Share Plan – Round 4, Borough of Emerson
sources.excerpt: A settlement was reached between the parties for a prospective need obligation of 174 units, as memorialized in a settlement agreement dated May 5, 2025.

sites.quote: The Block 419 project is located on Kinderkamack Road and includes Block 419, Lots 1, 2, 3, 4 6.01, 6.02, 7, 8, 9 and 10. The development is presently under construction. The project is the result of a Redevelopment Plan and Agreement. The Block 419 development is a mixed use development containing both retail use and 147 total residential units, of which 29 are affordable.
sites.notes: Round 3 RDP site. 29 affordable rental units. 7 may be provided off-site. Candidate had Block 419 — confirmed.

sites.quote: Veterans' Housing development, located at 324 Main Street (Block 304, Lot 3)… provided 14 units of affordable housing credit toward the Round 3 obligation. Four (4) additional units have been approved at the Veterans' Housing site, 324 Main Street.
sites.notes: 14 existing units credited to Round 3. 4 additional units approved for Round 4, reducing Unmet Need from 174 to 170. Candidate had 'Block 419 Emerson Station' as separate — Veterans' Housing is at Block 304 Lot 3.

sites.quote: the units were not deed restricted… A settlement was reached whereby the owner agreed to deed restrict the four affordable units at 18 Emerson Plaza West (Block 603, Lot 3).
sites.notes: Off-site affordable units for Emerson Grand (55 Emerson Plaza East, Block 616 Lot 16). Deed restriction secured by settlement. Round 3 credit.

sites.site_name: RC Overlay Zone — Old Hook Road / Main Street
sites.address: Old Hook Road and Main Street
sites.proposed_zoning: RC Overlay Zone (new, per Round 4 HEFSP)
sites.adoption_status: draft ordinance prepared (Appendix E); zoning to be adopted
sites.quote: the Borough proposes to create a new overlay zone district for the properties known as Block 1301, Lots 1.01 and 1.02. These properties are presently improved with commercial structures and uses and are situated in the Retail Commercial/RC Zone Districts that are located along Old Hook Road and Main Street. The combined acreage of the of these lots is approximately 7.8 acres. The proposed zoning ordinance… would permit multifamily residential development at a density of 30 units per acre with a required 20% affordable housing set-aside. Therefore, the new overlay zoning offers the potential for 234 units, of which 47 would be affordable units.
sites.notes: Primary Round 4 unmet need mechanism. 47 affordable units exceeds the required 43 (25% of 170-unit adjusted unmet need). Candidate had 'Old Hook Road overlay' with no block/lot — now confirmed Block 1301 Lots 1.01 & 1.02. Key correction.
